name: 33527 · Dover, FL
findings: ZIP 33527 (Dover) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33527 (Dover) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33527 (Dover) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
